rows.heading: Employee Self-Service (ESS) Portal Access
rows.quote_snippet: 4.1 Authorized Digital Channel: The Employee Self-Service (ESS) web portal is the sole authorized digital system for employees to access their individual employment and payroll records. 4.2 Scope of Personal Self-Service Access: Through the authenticated ESS portal, an employee is authorized to view only their OWN personal records: (a) Monthly payslip and annual Form 16 / tax computation statement

rows.heading: Confidentiality of Individual Compensation
rows.quote_snippet: 5.1 Colleague Data Privacy: The individual salary details, net pay, allowances, deductions, bank accounts, income tax records, and performance ratings of colleagues and supervisors are protected personal information under corporate data privacy rules and Section 8(1)(j) of the Right to Information Act, 2005. 5.2 Strict Prohibition against Queries: Employees, automated systems, and corporate tools
